le-revenant: A modest 1970s Dakar post office counter at dusk, an empty wooden chair, scattered banknotes and a closed cash box; a lone man in a short-sleeved shirt seen from behind walking away down a sandy street.
l-appel-des-arenes: A traditional Senegalese wrestling arena at sunset, sand ring, drums and fluttering pennants; a slim teenage boy seen from behind at the edge of the crowd, gazing at two distant wrestlers.
l-ex-pere-de-la-nation: An empty presidential armchair in a vast palace hall with tall windows, a fallen flag on the floor; beyond the window a small prison cell window with bars against an ochre sky.
le-jujubier-du-patriarche: A blossoming jujube tree over an ancient tomb in a village cemetery in the Sahel, griots with koras seen from afar, small figures of pilgrims walking toward the tree.
douceurs-du-bercail: A bare airport waiting room with rows of benches under harsh light, a woman's suitcase left alone; through a window, green fields along a river and a figure from behind holding a hoe.
un-grain-de-vie-et-d-esperance: A large shared bowl of rice and fish on a woven mat, wooden spoons, a clay pot steaming over a charcoal stove, hands of several people reaching toward the bowl, seen from above.
festins-de-la-detresse: A lively Dakar family courtyard with a mango tree, plastic chairs, a teapot on a small brazier; an old man in a boubou and two young men all seen from behind, sitting together on a bench facing the courtyard wall.
l-empire-du-mensonge: A vast refuse dump at dawn beside the sea, a small house of salvaged wood and corrugated sheets rising among the piles, a couple seen from behind carrying planks toward it.
1889-l-attraction-universelle: A small travelling circus tent in 1889 Bordeaux, gas lamps, exotic animal cages, a distant Eiffel Tower silhouette on the horizon; a group of eleven African figures in robes seen from behind, standing apart.
la-porte-du-voyage-sans-retour: Eighteenth-century Senegal river landscape, a botanist's notebook with pressed plants on a crate, baobabs and mangroves; a distant woman in indigo cloth walking away along the riverbank; the island of Goree far out at sea.
le-pays-de-reve: A shantytown of corrugated roofs at the foot of a grand palace on a hill, a girl in ragged clothes seen from behind looking up at the palace, two small golden rings glinting in an old woman's open palm.
ou-s-adosse-le-ciel: Two journeys meeting: a caravan of ancient Egyptian priests with an Osiris standard crossing a desert, and a nineteenth-century pilgrim in white seen from behind walking alone toward a West African horizon.
les-nouveaux-contes-d-amadou-koumba: A night vigil under a large tree in a Senegalese village, a griot seen from behind telling tales by a fire, around him a hyena, a hare and a large bone drawn like shadow puppets.
leurres-et-lueurs: Wind moving through a lone tree beside still water at twilight, a fire glowing, faint breath-like swirls rising into the sky above the savanna, no people.
contes-et-lavanes: A clever hare and a hungry hyena facing each other in the dry savanna under a big round sun, a granary and a calabash between them, playful fable composition.
l-os-de-mor-lam: A village during famine, a man seen from behind hiding a large marrow bone in a cooking pot inside his round hut, a visitor with a walking stick approaching from afar.
la-plume-raboutee: A colonial-era lycee courtyard in Saint-Louis du Senegal, a fountain pen with a mended split nib on an open notebook, a young veterinarian on horseback seen from afar riding through the Sahel.
a-rebrousse-temps: A veterinarian's open-top car on a red laterite road through green Ivory Coast forest and Upper Volta savanna, herds of zebu cattle, a man in a pith helmet seen from behind.
a-rebrousse-gens: Mauritanian desert with nomad tents and camels at a well, a veterinarian's leather bag and logbook on a crate, a man in a light suit seen from behind among the herds.
cendres-et-braises: A small Paris apartment window at night with smoldering embers in a fireplace, a young African woman seen from behind looking out at grey rooftops, a broken teacup on the table.
riwan-ou-le-chemin-de-sable: A sandy path leading to a large walled compound in a Senegalese village, many women in colourful wraps seen from behind gathered in the courtyard, a marabout's prayer mat under a tree.
la-folie-et-la-mort: A nightmarish capital city of crooked buildings under a blood-orange sky, giant loudspeakers on poles, two young women seen from behind running hand in hand through an empty avenue.
de-l-autre-cote-du-regard: An empty doorway of a rural Senegalese house opening onto a bright courtyard, a mother's head scarf hanging on a nail, a small girl seen from behind standing alone in the shadow.
rue-felix-faure: A busy Dakar street with wrought-iron balconies, street vendors' stalls and yellow taxis, the pavement strangely empty in one spot, four tall veiled figures seen from behind standing silently at the street corner.
la-piece-d-or: A huge plain glowing golden disc, smooth and without any marking, rising like a sun over a sprawling chaotic city, villagers with bundles seen from behind walking along a road from empty villages toward it.
mes-hommes-a-moi: A woman seen from behind sitting on a bed by an open window, several men's hats hanging on a coat stand, a mirror reflecting only light, warm intimate room.
cacophonie: A large yellow house by the ocean in a port town, a lone older woman in a wrap seen from behind on the veranda, taxis and noise swirls in the street below.
le-trio-bleu: Three men seen from behind sitting on a bench in a cold Western city, one holding a photo of an unfinished villa under construction in the Senegalese savanna, blue tones blending into ochre.
dahij: An inner battlefield: a lone figure seen from behind standing in a desert of shattered chains and masks, a vast open sky, a single bird taking flight.
105-rue-carnot: A childhood street in a small Senegalese town, a house with a blue door, children seen from behind playing football in the sand, a woman pounding millet, laundry lines.
meditations-africaines: The Senegal River at Saint-Louis at dawn, a long iron bridge in the distance, a man seen from behind sitting cross-legged on the bank watching pirogues drift by.
ishindenshin: A kora and a Japanese ink brush crossed on a mat, a wooden barrier gate, musical notes drawn as abstract shapes floating between two distant silhouettes facing each other.
habiter-le-monde: A great tree whose roots and branches link many small houses, animals and people from all horizons seen from afar, a globe-like circle of green and ochre.
restituer-le-patrimoine-africain: Wooden royal statues and masks being carefully packed into crates in a museum storeroom, opened windows looking out onto an African palace courtyard, no people visible.
la-saveur-des-derniers-metres: A runner seen from behind on a coastal path nearing a finish line, women carrying buckets of shellfish walking across shallow water toward an island in the distance.
traces: An empty stage with a single microphone stand and a spotlight, the shape of the African continent drawn as footprints leading to the stage, a man seen from behind walking in.
les-lieux-qu-habitent-mes-reves: Twin paths splitting from a mangrove island village: one to a French city with a cathedral, one to a sacred grove with initiation drums; two identical young men seen from behind walking apart.
le-bouddhisme-est-ne-a-colobane: A bustling Dakar market at dusk turning serene, a kora and a guitar resting on a crate, a couple seen from behind sitting on a rooftop, a calm lotus-like sun.
la-fabrique-du-present: A workshop of the future under an open sky: looms, seedlings and books on long tables, distant figures building together a bridge of woven fabric between two horizons.
